item.title: Casper DDA plans to add permanent tree lighting to parts of downtown
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — In an effort to enhance the atmosphere and attractiveness of Casper’s downtown, the Downtown Development Authority plans to add year-round lighting to trees in parts of the district. DDA Executive Director Melissa Huggett said plans are to add lighting to 26 trees along Center and Wolcott streets. The lighting would be programmable, […]
